title: Wazi Evaluation Fixture
description: Compatibility fixture carrying REAL contract records. The validator schema-checks manifest/host/policy with their actual schemas, then runs hard filters at evaluationTime (injected clock, never wall clock). Missing mandatory facts are schema failures mapped to missing-mandatory-fact.

manifest.description: Validated against app-manifest.schema.json by the validator.

host.description: Validated against host-profile.schema.json by the validator.

policy.description: Validated against policy-bundle.schema.json when present; defaults to the example policy.

registryState.description: Revocation lives in the registry, not in the signed manifest.
